rationale: Monotonic Volt-VAR curve designed to mitigate voltage violations: injects reactive power (q=0.2) at t_low to raise voltage from 0.94 to 0.9512 pu, and absorbs reactive power (q=-0.4) at t_high to lower voltage from 1.07 to 1.0476 pu. All q_fraction values are within [-1,1] and respect inverter capability limits (max 80 kVAR for t_low/t_high, 60 kVAR for t_nom). Curve is strictly monotonic non-increasing in q_fraction as voltage rises.
